notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dross Harverster's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
